name: Dark wet roots 047
modifier: roots angling across rather than straight down
prompt: a FEW long separate tree roots creeping down over old stone, each root its own independent strand with wide bare empty gaps between them, a little moss or a small fern where they touch, the tree they belong to is FAR ABOVE and out of sight — the roots never join or converge, no trunk, no stump, no root crown, no bundle, no starting point anywhere, each strand simply thinning to a fine tip at both ends, lush fantasy RPG nature art, drifting off one side, no straight edges, no border, transparent background, no rock or wall behind it, dark wet roots, roots angling across rather than straight down, towering, many times human height, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.
